title: Feedback
body: It has too many features that one just doesn’t have time to complete, even though I didn’t choose all (not even half of these). It is not a newly vision of the topic - some things I know muself (like creating a new habit but it is too much to do it every week). Rather one should try a new habit and measure how it is going week after week and see progress. Some motivation within groups or just reminders why it is good for you (bases on science) would be really helpful. It is hard to motivate yourself. My feedback goes to Michael who asked me to write it.
author: K88ginurk

title: Осторожно, обман
body:
Я загрузила UltiSelf, чтобы попробовать бесплатную пробную версию. После окончания пробного периода с меня ежемесячно взимали плату без моего согласия. Я не могу отменить подписку через App Store, так как она не отображается в моих активных подписках. Я обращалась в их службу поддержки, но не получила ответа.
Само приложение не оправдало моих ожиданий, пришлось закрывать карточку, чтобы остановить списывание денег

author: Vla8888

title: Scam
body:
I downloaded UltiSelf to try the free trial, but I am very disappointed with the app. After the trial period ended, I was charged monthly without my consent. I cannot cancel the subscription through the App Store, as it doesn't appear in my active subscriptions. I've reached out to their support team multiple times, but I have received no response.

The app itself didn’t meet my expectations, and now I’m stuck with recurring charges. It’s very frustrating, and I would not recommend this app to anyone until they address these issues.

Please be cautious before signing up for any trials with this app.
